title: What I Think Out Loud
notes: Star (~35%) = she is the clear hero. Supporting = story leads; she may appear partial/distant/edge — not the hero. World = no her. Do not put her in every frame.
story: Late night: she wants to stay and be held, but the words she needs stay trapped. The city keeps her secrets — wet streets, empty transit, unsent thoughts — until everything nearly erases.
